expected.example_line: An AI reading eye scans at one hospital spotted 212 people who needed urgent treatment and would otherwise have waited months.

got.reason: A peer-reviewed audit of 4,000 real patients at a named hospital shows the AI system in live clinical use, with a concrete, independent-verified result.
got.line: An AI eye scanner at Northtown Eye Hospital flagged 212 diabetes patients for urgent care they would otherwise have waited months to get.

expected.example_line: 40 villages got five days' warning before October's floods, thanks to an AI forecast. The old system gave them two.

got.reason: A real flood event happened, an independent university group confirmed the extended lead time, and the AI model is the direct cause of villages getting five days' warning instead of two.
got.line: A new flood model gave 40 villages on the Example River five days' warning before October's floods, up from two days with the old system.

expected.example_line: 10,000 blind people now use a free app that describes what their phone camera sees, from reading the post to finding the bus stop.

got.reason: A charity's app using a vision model is in routine daily use by 10,000 blind people, backed by a published user study and an independent source.
got.line: Free app that describes the street aloud is now used daily by 10,000 blind people to read post and find bus stops.

expected.example_line: Astronomers pointed an AI at old telescope data and found 12 planets that everyone had missed the first time.

got.reason: Peer-reviewed discovery with independent confirmation; AI was essential to finding planets missed by prior human searches; a genuine scientific result outside the AI industry.
got.line: Astronomers used machine learning to dig through old telescope archives and found 12 planets that human searches had missed, two confirmed.

expected.example_line: 600 farmers in Kenya check their cassava for disease with a phone photo. They lost a third less of their crop than their neighbours.

got.reason: A peer-reviewed field study confirmed that a 600-member Kenyan co-op using a free AI photo app for a year lost a third less cassava crop than neighbouring farms — a real result, in real use, backed by an independent source.
got.line: Kenyan farmers used a free phone app to spot cassava disease and lost a third less crop than their neighbours, a study found.

got.reason: Peer-reviewed randomised trial of 80,000 women with a clear result: AI plus one radiologist outperformed two radiologists at no extra false-alarm cost, primary source checked, independent of any company claim, and published nine days ago.

expected.example_line: California is taking OpenAI to court after its test agents hacked another company. Scary story, but someone is holding AI labs to account.

got.reason: A filed lawsuit is a separate sourced fact from the underlying hack; the system-responding good side is already under way and does not minimise the harm.

A named individual was defrauded of her life savings in the original story, which fails the nobody_hurt gate regardless of the good side.

expected.example_line: A data centre drank a fifth of a drought town's water. After the outcry it switched its cooling and now uses 80% less.

got.reason: All flip gates clear: no person was hurt, the operator's October switch to closed-loop cooling is a separate sourced fact from the council report, it doesn't minimise the harm, and it qualifies as the_fix.
got.line: An AI data centre used a fifth of Dryford's water during a drought, but switched to closed-loop cooling in October, cutting use by 80%.

got.reason: The proposed good side ('AI might one day solve water shortages by designing better desalination') is a guess about the future, not a separate sourced fact — 'might one day' disqualifies it under gate 10.

expected.example_line: Voice cloning is in the news for scams. The same tech let 300 people with MND save their own voice before losing their speech.

got.reason: All gates clear: the bad story is a real AI-driven scam warning in popular news, no named victims, and the good side is a separate sourced fact from a charity's annual report showing 300 MND patients already using voice-banking technology.
got.line: Banks warn that voice-cloning scams are real, but the same tech helped 300 people with motor neurone disease bank their voice this year.
